name: pstack_spawn
obligation: Register a tool named pstack_spawn that spawns one isolated Pi child agent.
Require a non-empty task string as the only mandatory spawn parameter and reject calls that omit it.
Default the child role to general and build a per-role prompt that wraps poteto-agent, comment-sicko, and investigator inputs while leaving other roles as the raw task.
Accept an explicit model only as provider/id or inherit-parent/auto and refuse an unmapped bare marketing slug.
Resolve an omitted model through the role model config and fall back to the parent model when the role has no configured value.
Resolve the child tool allowlist in the order explicit tools, readonly or auto-readonly role, then inherited parent tools, else full discovery.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@resolveTools follows explicit, readonly, auto-readonly, and inherit order

obligation: Treat an explicit background as decisive, and an omitted background as detached only for the poteto-agent role or an explicit poteto flag; every other role is synchronous by default.
Persist full child output by default for background or five-minute-plus children and honor the explicit and PSTACK_PERSIST_OUTPUT overrides.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@shouldPersistOutput resolves explicit, env, and timeout defaults

obligation: Accept only isolated or ephemeral for sessionMode and default to isolated when unset or unrecognized.
Mint a fresh isolated session directory under the child cwd and reject resume combined with ephemeral.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@resolveChildSessionDir rejects resume plus ephemeral and mints isolated dirs

obligation: Fail closed when resumeSessionDir or resumeJobId names a missing target or a job without a recorded session directory.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@resolveResumeSessionDirParam fails closed on unknown and dir-less jobs

obligation: Bound timeoutMs to 1000..1800000 at the parameter boundary and default it to 600000 milliseconds.
Build the child argv in json mode with --model, a session flag, --continue only when resuming, and the prompt last.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@buildChildPiArgs marks resume with continue and leaves fresh isolated without it

obligation: Pass the parent model and child role into the child environment as PSTACK_PARENT_MODEL and PSTACK_CHILD_ROLE.
Never inherit the parent conversation history into the child process.
Never inherit the parent MCP bindings into the child process.
Enforce a global child concurrency cap defaulting to 8 and clamp the PSTACK_MAX_CONCURRENCY override to 1 through 32.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@childConcurrencyStats reports the idle cap and task ceiling

obligation: Deliver the background completion as a follow-up message carrying the job id, role, model, exit code, and sessionDir.
Return the foreground result inline as a pstack_spawn summary with role, model, exit code, and sessionDir.

Resolve synchronous execution for routed skills that consume a child result inline (how, why, interrogate, reflect, no-comments), either by passing background:false at those call sites or by resolving the default to sync for those roles.

name: pstack_jobs
obligation: Register a tool named pstack_jobs that lists, polls, awaits, and aborts detached spawn jobs.
Accept action list, status, await, abort, or cancel and require an id for every action except list.
Print the list header with active, cap, and waiting counts and order rows by start time.
Show status output truncated to 8000 characters and fail with unknown job for a missing id.
Await a job to a terminal state by polling and throw a timeout error when the deadline passes.
Track each job through queued, running, done, failed, and aborted states and let abort flip a queued or running job to aborted.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@background job registry lists, aborts, and clears jobs

obligation: Keep job records queryable across follow-ups within the session and abort all jobs on session shutdown.

name: pstack_swarm
obligation: Register a tool named pstack_swarm that runs N parallel workers and aggregates one report.
Always isolate each worker in a unique worktree even when N equals 1.
Order the report by the declared selection rule (coverage, first-pass, rank-all, or best-of), name the worker the rule selects, and refuse an unknown rule.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/swarm-selection.test.ts@ranks and picks per the declared rule

obligation: N is the total worker count: the schema accepts more than the concurrency cap and pstack_swarm batches the workers in sequential waves, and the routed skill must not claim a per-call cap.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/swarm-selection.test.ts@the global concurrency cap is 8 and the routed skill does not restate it as a per-call cap

obligation: Provide a synchronous barrier that returns only after all workers complete and their results are aggregated into one report.

name: pstack_arena
obligation: Register a tool named pstack_arena that runs N parallel candidates and requires a shared prompt with one to eight candidates.
Always isolate each candidate in a unique worktree even when N equals 1.
Plumb a per-candidate output path into the child prompt so the candidate writes its artifact there.
Resolve the cross-judge model from judgeModel or the arena cross-judge pool and force its tools to the readonly allowlist.
Append the cross-judge verdict to the report as a cross-judge section naming the judge model.

name: /setup-pstack
obligation: Provide a command /setup-pstack that writes the chosen budget into the HOME pstack-models.json config.
verification: test@tests/layers/05-rpc/setup-pstack-ui.test.mjs@setup-pstack writes the chosen budget to the HOME config

obligation: Leave the config file unwritten when the confirm is rejected.
verification: test@tests/layers/05-rpc/setup-pstack-ui.test.mjs@setup-pstack cancelled on a rejected confirm does not write

obligation: Read the project-level .pi/pstack-models.json before the user-level file when resolving a role model at spawn.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/models-role-cwd.test.ts@reads the project model config when given a cwd

obligation: Require a config with version 1 and an object roles map, skipping malformed files.
Write per-role defaults that map code roles to the detected provider/id or inherit-parent and judgment roles to the mapped judgment model.
Pick array role values by index clamped to the array length so the list length sets the fan-out.
Append the validated model roles section to the system prompt on every before_agent_start.
Detect the preferred model from PI_MODEL or PSTACK_DEFAULT_MODEL then from the Pi agent settings files.

name: pstack_task
obligation: Register a tool named pstack_task that compiles a multidimensional policy and runs one policy-guarded child agent.
Compile a per-role policy whose filesystem axis and integrations axis stay independent, so an investigator keeps integrations inherited while its filesystem is read-only.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/policy-compile.test.ts@role defaults keep a read-only filesystem with inherited integrations

obligation: Enforce the compiled policy at the child tool boundary for the filesystem, shell, git, and network axes.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/policy-guard.test.ts@guard blocks filesystem, shell, git, and network writes

obligation: Forward the resolved thinking level to the child argv as a thinking flag.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/task-contract.test.ts@pstack_task passes the resolved thinking level into child argv

obligation: Fail closed when environment hosted has no PSTACK_HOSTED_URL, naming services/worker as the prerequisite instead of downgrading to a local child.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/task-contract.test.ts@hosted environment without PSTACK_HOSTED_URL fails closed naming services/worker

obligation: Gate integration tool names on one shared capability table so a capability outside the grant list is blocked while a granted capability runs.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/policy-guard.test.ts@integrations grant blocks a non-granted capability tool and allows a granted one
